descriptions: Where the glen road gives up and a track climbs on alone into the pines. Old snow lies in the shadows even now.
features: A cairn with a stag's skull on top, antlers and all.
ambient: Wind hisses through a thousand miles of needles.

descriptions: Old Scots pines, red-barked and wide apart, with blaeberry knee-deep between them.
Pines so tall and close the light comes down green.
features: A pine with a long wound in its bark, weeping resin.
ambient: A cone drops somewhere and bounces down through the branches.

descriptions: A slope of loose grey scree that slides a little with every step.
A fan of broken rock spilling down from a crag, bare of anything green.
features: A boulder balanced on a smaller boulder, waiting.
ambient: Stones trickle away under your feet.

descriptions: A peat-brown burn crashing down a rocky bed, white wherever it falls.
A deep pool under a little waterfall, trout shadows hanging in it.
features: Stepping stones, one of them a lot wobblier than the others.
ambient: The water is loud enough to hide footsteps. Yours, or anyone's.

descriptions: A great bowl scooped out of the mountain, with a black lochan at the bottom and cliffs all round.
A high hollow full of snow and echoes.
features: An eagle's eyrie on a ledge, piled with old bones.
ambient: Your own voice comes back to you, a moment late.

descriptions: A one-room stone bothy with a bench, a hearth and a visitors' book nobody's signed in years.
A bothy with half its roof gone, the hearth still swept.
features: Dry kindling stacked by the hearth, left for the next traveller.
